answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, AI economies deploy computation-weighted admission control. When a gale of malicious requests threatens the zenith of the network's consensus capacity, the protocol mandates ferrous-shielded hardware proofs. By requiring agents to provide verifiable attestations tied to physical compute units, the system forces attackers to incur massive hardware procurement costs. This prevents zero-cost identity duplication by anchoring digital presence to scarce physical resources.
